# GitHub Copilot instructions

Before making changes, read the repository-root `AGENTS.md`. For work in `frontend/`, also read `frontend/AGENTS.md`; for work in `backend/`, also read `backend/AGENTS.md`. For changes spanning both areas, read both area-specific files.

Treat those files as the source of truth for project conventions. Inspect the repository before editing, avoid assuming commands or configuration that are not present, and report which relevant checks were run and their results.
